rollback_evidence: 1.0.12 junos port ownership (J31-J33), measured on vJunos-switch 26.2R1.7 (vJunos-switch, virtual KVM, verification record) with the safeguard of the Junos interface profile: an empty 'commit confirmed 10 comment "netops-<id>"' first, the change committed with 'commit confirmed 10 comment "netops-change"', the confirmation 'commit comment "netops-<id>-ok"'; an expiry returns the configuration before the change. The key is the address of the server as Junos shows it (IPv4, or IPv6 compressed in lower case). Lines: 'set system ntp server <ip>' or 'set system ntp server <ip> prefer' (one display set line; deleting prefer leaves the bare line), 'delete system ntp server <ip> prefer' and 'delete system ntp server <ip>' (the last server removes the ntp stanza, no empty container is left). Other servers and the rest of the ntp stanza are not touched; a server with key, version, routing-instance or nts is refused.
